title: Change Admin Panel button font colors to blue for better visibility

requirements.summary: Change the font color of all primary action buttons in the Admin Panel to blue for better visibility
acceptanceCriteria: All primary action buttons in AdminLogin component have blue text color
All primary action buttons in AdminPanel component have blue text color
All primary action buttons in ProductManagement component have blue text color
Button text remains legible with sufficient contrast against backgrounds
Blue color is consistent across all admin panel buttons

file_operations.description: Update all primary action buttons ('Log In', 'Register', Internet Identity login/register buttons) to use blue text color. Apply text-blue-600 class or equivalent to button text while maintaining existing button structure and accessibility. Ensure sufficient contrast against button backgrounds for WCAG AA compliance.

Update the 'Log Out' button text color to blue. Apply text-blue-600 class or equivalent while maintaining existing button styling and layout. Ensure the blue text color is clearly visible against the button background.

Update all primary action buttons ('Add Product', 'Edit', 'Delete', 'Save', 'Cancel') to use blue text color. Apply text-blue-600 class or equivalent to all action button text while preserving existing button functionality, dialogs, and layouts. Ensure consistent blue text color across all product management actions.
